name: Audio Visualizer
tagline: Audio visualizer for local media playback.
blurb: Audio Visualizer is an Android app for playing local audio and video files while showing visual effects.
description:
Audio Visualizer is an Android app for playing local audio and video files while showing visual effects.

Features:
- Local playback of audio and video files
- Visualizer display with basic media controls
- Built for offline use without Google services
- Focused on local media playback for F-Droid distribution

Source code:
https://github.com/Rino-program/Audio-Visualizer
